item.summary: fix(agents): redact reflected credentials from native PDF provider error body and reason phrase (#125499) * fix(agents): redact reflected credentials from native PDF provider error body and reason phrase * fix(agents): centralize provider error credential redaction Redact the exact authentication values sent by native PDF and MiniMax VLM requests before provider-controlled response fields reach agent-facing errors.
